objective: The constitutional, oracle and lifecycle planes are live and their closed Rust population is release-accountable through a fail-empty wrapper.
falsifiable_claim: npm run check:constitutional-oracle-plane pins by exact name the system_policy (2) and system_oracle (7) daemon test populations, refuses when --list does not return exactly the pinned set or when the run passes fewer than the pinned count, then runs check:work-items; a renamed, deleted, ignored or newly added focused test is red until the pin is deliberately moved.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: npm run mutate:constitutional-oracle-plane plants (a) an absent test name, refused by the source binding; (b) a name whose fn exists but whose module path the harness cannot list, refused at --list; (c) an empty population, refused outright — the wrapper proves it can fail on its own finding before it is trusted green.
remaining_nonclaims: The wrapper proves the pinned tests execute and pass; it does not widen what those tests assert. The unit's acceptance clauses are proven only to the extent the pinned tests prove them.
A CI floor is not yet pinned for these root-workspace wrappers; verifier-floors.v1.json covers hypervisor-app journey verifiers only.
